name: Default
shortDescription: Private portfolio and net worth tracker for investments, spending and budgets, served as a password-protected web app backed by SQLite.

alerts.message: Sign in with the generated WEALTHFOLIO_PASSWORD environment variable. Wealthfolio has a single password and no user accounts; change the variable and redeploy to rotate it.
WF_SECRET_KEY encrypts stored API keys and broker credentials. Keep it with your backups and never change it on an existing installation.
